Estimated meal before eating:
- Roast beef, about 3 slices: ~100 g, ~200 kcal.
- Potato/vegetable frittata slice: ~100 g, ~180 kcal.
- Noodles with meat in sauce: ~300 g, ~500 kcal.
- Coleslaw: ~80 g, ~100 kcal.
- Cola in a glass: ~250 ml, ~105 kcal. This is a drink, so I left it out of the food mass.
- Milk drink in a bottle: ~250 ml, ~150 kcal. It appears to be partly consumed, with some residue left in the bottle.

The second photo shows nearly everything eaten. Small residues remain on the plates, and some liquid is left in the bottle and glass.

Eaten:
- Food, at ~95% of the solid items: (100 + 100 + 300 + 80) × 0.95 ≈ 550 g and (200 + 180 + 500 + 100) × 0.95 ≈ 931 kcal.
- Drinks: cola ~105 kcal and milk drink ~130 kcal, so ~235 kcal.

Total is about 931 + 235 ≈ 1165 kcal. For mass I included the drinks, since they were consumed: 550 + 240 (cola) + 200 (milk drink) ≈ 990 g.
